cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Analysing dance performance involves watching closely and breaking down what you observe into component parts

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Live performance offers a full sensory experience — you feel the energy, scale and atmosphere of the work

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Recorded performance allows repeated viewing, enabling closer analysis of specific moments and details

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: A structured approach uses the four content categories: action, dynamics, space and relationships

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: When analysing, always consider the choreographic intention as the central reference point

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Effective note-taking during or after viewing helps capture observations before they are forgotten

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Analysis should consider design elements: costume, lighting, set and aural setting alongside movement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: The AO4 framework requires analysis to explain how and why choreographic choices create meaning

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Comparing sections of a dance reveals structure, contrast and development over time

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: Analysis of professional works must reference specific choreographic features and their purpose

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: When watching live, focus on the whole stage first, then zoom in on specific dancers or moments

cards.front: Recall a key point about Analysing Dance Performance
cards.back: AQA exam questions often ask you to analyse a specific moment, section or feature of a work

cards.front: What should you know about gcse dance exam tips — analysing dance performance?
cards.back: 1. For Analysing Dance Performance questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Analysing Dance Performance 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
Explain how you would approach analysing a professional dance work for the AQA 8236 written exam. Describe your method and give examples. [6 marks]

AO1 (Performance): Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of analysing dance performance, including choreographic processes, performing skills and dance appreciation relevant to AQA 8236. AO2 (Choreography): Apply knowledge and understanding of analysing dance performance through the creative process of choreography, selecting and using movement material and choreographic devices.
